messages:
Sasha: FYI BeaconPay is seeing sustained p50->p99 tail latency regressions on Dedicated pool B. CS just escalated P1 (SLA risk). Requesting owners and immediate plan. details: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2468

Leah (cust-success): Customer reported ~8% error rate 5m ago, SLA window breached, they want ETA on fix or temporary workaround. They are on dedicated capacity.

Morgan: I'm on it. Initial hypothesis: cross-zone routing causing cache misses after yesterday's rollout. Can we confirm pool B nodes had kernel update?

Alex: Noted. I looked at pool B nodes — one host had a reboot at 02:12 UTC. kube drain happened, but we saw increased p99. Rolling back kernel is risky. Suggest rolling traffic to pool A as immediate mitigation.

Sasha: Who can own the traffic shift? Need commitment within 15m. Impacting client SLAs.

Kei: I can do routing change, but need confirmation from infra. Steps: 1) update routing policy 2) shift 20% -> 100% 3) monitor.

Alex: I'll own infra verification and health checks. I have a quick command to validate cache warmup:
```
kubectl exec -n redwood-runtime $POD -- curl -sSf localhost:8080/healthz; redis-cli -h cache-b.local info | grep hits
```

Morgan: I'll prepare a canary rollback PR for yesterday's runtime change. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/PR-4821 needs a +1 and CI green. If traffic shift works, we can keep it until we hotfix.

Leah (cust-success): Customer wants timeline. Can we commit to <2 hours for mitigation and 24 hours for full fix?

Sasha: Tentatively yes for mitigation if KEI/ALEX confirm. Full fix contingent on root cause. Morgan how long for PR review + patch? 

Morgan: I can get the PR ready in 30m, but need one more review from runtime team. @Alex can you be that reviewer? Also adding test run in staging.

Alex: Will review in next 20m. If CI passes, we can promote patch to prod after Canary.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job: traffic-shift to pool-a starting 2468003000 for 15m window. Logs: https://logs.redwood/2468003000

Kei: Starting traffic shift now (keeping 20% for 5m to monitor) :thumbsup: 

Sasha: Please ping here once 5m checks clear. Also post final rollback instructions if needed.

Kei: 5m checks: p50/p95 down to expected, no error increase. Holding for another 5m.

Morgan: PR updated, CI passing except flaky test (re-running). @Alex please review.

Alex: Reviewed and approved. Merge on green.

Leah (cust-success): Customer notified about mitigation. They asked for postmortem and ETA for fix. I'll coordinate.

Sasha: Great. Owners: Kei (mitigation/routing), Alex (infra validation & review), Morgan (runtime PR/hotfix), Leah (customer comms). Keep this thread for updates. :white_check_mark:
